subject: Provisioning owner evidence & SCIM reconciliation request
messages:
From: Elena Ross <elena.ross@medledger.com>
To: vivek_kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@medledger.com
Date: Wed, 10 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request - provisioning evidence and owner mapping for SOC2 review

Hi Vivek,

We're preparing for MedLedger's SOC 2 vendor security review and the auditor asked for a concise package showing how user provisioning and role ownership are managed for our Redwood integration. Specifically they're requesting:

- SCIM sync logs for a 7-day window (most recent full week) showing adds/updates/deletes
- A role ownership matrix identifying which internal Red- roles are the authoritative owners for each role (and the date of last change)
- Short justification notes for how least-privilege is enforced for high-risk roles

Can you provide the above or point me to an evidence bundle? We prefer CSV/Excel exports and a one-page explanation we can attach to the auditor request. Also please confirm who internally owns the provisioning flow so the auditor has a contact.

Thanks,
Elena
Elena Ross
Security Operations, MedLedger Inc
elena.ross@medledger.com

--
Attachment request: example auditor checklist referenced as "SOC2-Provisioning-Reqs.pdf"

From: vivek_kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Ross <elena.ross@medledger.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 10 Jun 2026 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request - provisioning evidence and owner mapping for SOC2 review

Hi Elena — thanks for the clear list. We can assemble that.

Plan (high level):
- We will export the SCIM sync deltas for the requested 7-day window (CSV) and include a short parsed summary of add/update/delete counts.
- We'll produce a role ownership matrix (CSV + human-readable one-pager) showing owners, last modified timestamps, and change justification where available.
- We'll provide a short "least privilege controls" note covering RBAC review cadence, automated SCIM mappings, and exception handling.

Internal owners: I'll coordinate delivery. @karthik_iyer can you pull the SCIM deltas and a role snapshot from the provisioning service? @marissa_cole please prepare the role-owner matrix and the one-page explanation. @ben_carter can you confirm there are no outstanding PII-related redactions we need for the export?

Target delivery: EOD Friday (2026-06-12). If the auditor needs anything sooner, tell me the hard deadline and we'll prioritize.

Thanks — Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Solutions Engineering, Redwood Inference
vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai

From: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: vivek_kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 10 Jun 2026 11:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request - provisioning evidence and owner mapping for SOC2 review

On Wed, Jun 10, 2026 at 10:03 AM vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai wrote:
> Plan (high level):
> - We will export the SCIM sync deltas for the requested 7-day window (CSV) and include a short parsed summary of add/update/delete counts.

I can run the SCIM exporter and produce the raw CSV. A couple of small clarifications I need from Elena to make sure the export matches auditor expectations:

1) Exact 7-day window: do you want last Monday-Sunday (2026-06-01 to 2026-06-07) or the 7 days immediately prior to today (2026-06-03 to 2026-06-09)?
2) Are we allowed to include user email addresses in the CSV, or should we pseudonymize/email-hash to hide PII? Auditors typically want identifiable user accounts, but MedLedger policy might prefer hashes.

Workback:
- If window confirmed today, I can produce the raw CSV within 90 minutes and a parsed summary within 3 hours.
- I'll also generate a delta export that includes the SCIM operation type and timestamp and the provisioning system's request IDs for traceability.

Ben — if you can confirm PII guidance that affects the export content, I'll proceed.

-karthik
Karthik Iyer
Staff Engineer, Provisioning Services
karthik_iyer@redwood.ai

From: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: vivek_kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 11 Jun 2026 14:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request - provisioning evidence and owner mapping for SOC2 review

Hi team — attaching the artifacts I pulled and a short narrative. See attachments: role_mapping_snapshot_20260610.csv and provisioning_owner_matrix_20260610.xlsx. I also pushed a supporting doc to Drive: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1a2b3c-scim-sync-export

Quick summary:
- Role mapping snapshot: includes role_id, role_name, assigned_permissions (high-level), owner (name + email), last_owner_change (ISO time).
- Owner matrix: includes business justification text for high-risk roles (Admin, BillingAdmin, DataExport), links to ticket(s) that recorded approvals, and date of last attestation.
- Least-privilege note (one-pager): we run quarterly role reviews with product and security; critical roles require approval in the Governance Jira board (SEC-789).

I also included a small sample of the SCIM sync log (scim_sync_log_20260609.csv) per karthik's export — this is a 24-hour sample. If the auditor needs the full 7-day raw export, karthik can upload it; I wanted to get these files out now so Elena has material to review.

Action items left:
- karthik: full 7-day SCIM delta export (confirm PII decision)
- ben: confirm whether we should redact or hash email addresses for external delivery

-Marissa
Marissa Cole
Security Compliance Manager, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai

--
Attachments: role_mapping_snapshot_20260610.csv, provisioning_owner_matrix_20260610.xlsx, scim_sync_log_20260609.csv

From: vivek_kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Ross <elena.ross@medledger.com>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 12 Jun 2026 15:47:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request - provisioning evidence and owner mapping for SOC2 review

Hi Elena — attaching the deliverables we discussed. Summary below and attachments included.

What we delivered:
- scim_sync_log_20260609.csv (24-hour sample provided earlier; full 7-day export available on request)
- role_mapping_snapshot_20260610.csv (role_id, role_name, assigned_permissions summary, owner, last_owner_change)
- provisioning_owner_matrix_20260610.xlsx (owner contacts, business justifications, attestation dates)
- one-page least-privilege note (embedded in the XLSX as a cover sheet)

Key points to share with the auditor:
- SCIM exports contain operation type, timestamp, target account id/email, and provisioning request id for traceability. We can include full user emails if you confirm it's acceptable; otherwise we will provide a SHA256 hash column for PII protection.
- Owner matrix shows explicit owners for all roles; high-risk roles have documented approvals and quarterly attestations via SEC-789 in our Jira board.
- We enforce least privilege through automated SCIM role mappings backed by an RBAC review cadence and change-approval workflow (Governance Jira + change ticket).

Next steps: If the auditor needs the full 7-day raw export with identifiable emails, please confirm by EOD and we'll provide a secure link. If you'd like to review with us, I'm happy to schedule a 30-minute walkthrough next week.

Best,
Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Solutions Engineering, Redwood Inference
vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0186
